card.name: The word to after asked or instructed
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after verbs of telling someone to act, such as "asked", "instructed" or "required by law". It also fires on a few other words where a required action is about to be named.

modes.label: Asked/instructed to
modes.description: "to" after asked, instructed or instruct patients, before the action required of them.
modes.example: - You will be asked<< to>> remove your jewelry or other objects that interfere

modes.label: Other lead-ins to a duty
modes.description: A comma or "then" that introduces what people must do or what happens next in a sequence.
modes.example: He<< then>> underwent a functional MRI brain scan while simultaneously

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning "must" or "need to" (Chinese) and away from "optional" or "may choose".
card.plain: It marks the point where someone is told what they must do, as in "you will be asked to ...".
